performance.verdict: Campaigns fully dark 28 days; organic holding but GBP pipeline broken.

findings.text: Meta and Google spend is $0 for all 28 days in the window — zero leads generated; the paid engine is completely off.
Extension with Marwan unsigned past 2026-08-31 deadline; no contract gates the next 3 months of paid activation.
SMS automation and Zoho Voice access both overdue since 2026-08-31; contact-rate bottleneck remains unresolved with 0 GHL appointments.
GBP actions dropped to 0 for last 8 days (Sep 1–7) vs 14–13 daily avg in Aug 11–26; pipeline reads 0 GBP but 149 28-day total — likely a data feed break, not true zero activity.
Search clicks hit 0 on Sep 7 after ranging 10–44/day prior; 3-day signal (Sep 5–7: 10, 12, 0) vs prior 3 (Sep 2–4: 44, 34, 34) shows a sharp drop — possible crawl or GSC feed issue.

suggestions.text: Resolve GBP data feed break immediately — 0 actions for 8 straight days contradicts 149 28-day total.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions read zero for every day Sep 1–7, despite 149 total actions recorded in the 28-day window (53 calls, 96 web clicks). Investigate the data connector or GBP API pull for a broken sync. Success check: daily GBP action counts resume populating by 2026-09-11. If confirmed broken, repair and backfill before next performance cycle.

suggestions.text: Escalate Marwan extension signature and Zoho Voice access — both block paid reactivation and CRM intake.
suggestions.monday_update: The Marwan contract extension is unsigned past its 2026-08-31 deadline and gates the next 3 months of paid activity. Zoho Voice access and SMS automation are also overdue, leaving the contact-rate bottleneck unresolved with 0 GHL appointments in 28 days. Sohib to chase Marwan for signature and Andrew for Zoho Voice access this week. Success check: extension signed and Zoho Voice granted by 2026-09-12, enabling paid reactivation planning.

suggestions.text: Watch search clicks — Sep 7 zero-click day after 10–44/day range; confirm feed or ranking issue by Sep 11.
suggestions.monday_update: Search clicks fell to 0 on Sep 7 after a prior-3-day average of 34/day (Sep 2–4). This is a single-day event and may be a GSC data lag or indexing issue. No action warranted yet. Re-check the 3-day window on 2026-09-11; if clicks remain below 10 for 3 consecutive days, escalate to SEO for a crawl and ranking audit.
